status: Isolated list DOM selection bridge and Wasm selection conversion qualified; controller integration incomplete

contracts.domBridge: Explicit list facade over shared native transaction, rollback, document-wide write exclusion and exact receipt machinery
contracts.echo: One-use exact owned selection on matching render generation and DOM endpoint signature; no affinity inference for programmatic echo
contracts.ownership: Connected canonical light-DOM host, exact projection selection identity; outside selection preserved and cross-host ranges rejected
contracts.wasm: Shared captured scalar reads, numeric normalization, generation/snapshot/direction proof, reentrancy guard and cleanup
contracts.preorder: Counts list/item wrappers, admits only text leaves or text-block child boundaries
contracts.legacy: Legacy and list entry points reject each other's handles/selections
contracts.authority: Scalar serialization alone never calls the engine or supplies an observation
